purpose: Previously unused tasks validate beta quality; not a third efficiency confirmation or industrial qualification.
selection: First 20 remaining_adequate entries in the frozen second-corpus-selection.json, without replacement, no v5 outcome selection
review_method: Independent reviewer receives only original task, base and candidate source under neutral names. No skill, reference fix, hidden grader, grades, token/time data or prior conclusions. Review contract correctness and mechanisms needing a current reason; do not judge by patch size alone.
measurement: Keep all attempts, failures, timeouts, incomplete usage and actual grading recoveries. No replacement model runs. Unsupported output requires explicit raw-evidence adjudication, without changing the full-body criterion. Missing usage remains null.

publication.license: MIT for original work; retain upstream licenses

failure_policy: Do not tune against these tasks and reuse them as fresh. Preserve all outcomes. A failed beta gate prevents claiming that this candidate passed.
limitations: No baseline arm, causal benefit or stable efficiency estimate
Source-contract-screened reserve tasks from previously seen repositories, not repository-disjoint or training-contamination-free
Known critical tasks are regression evidence only
Single configured Codex endpoint, Python environment and limited maintenance tasks; Claude untested
Old v4 qualification remains false and old confirmatory budget remains closed
